info.name: Smart Campus System
info.description:
Comprehensive integration test suite for Smart Campus Microservices via API Gateway (port 8080).
Covers all 9 integration scenarios defined in WORK_PLAN.md.

item.name: 01 - Scenario 1: Get All Residents (3 seeded students)

request.description: Returns 3 seeded residents: Aarav Sharma (A-101, active), Diya Patel (A-102, active), and Rohan Iyer (B-205, inactive).

item.name: 02 - Scenario 2: Create Pass for Host 1 (Active -> APPROVED)

request.description: Host 1 is active, so pass status should be APPROVED and a PASS_CREATED log should be recorded.

item.name: 03 - Scenario 2 Verification: Check Security Logs for PASS_CREATED

request.description: Verifies that PASS_CREATED log was recorded by security-alert-service.

item.name: 04 - Scenario 3: Create Pass for Host 3 (Inactive -> REJECTED)

request.description: Host 3 (Rohan Iyer) is inactive, so pass status should be REJECTED and UNAUTHORIZED_HOST_ATTEMPT alert triggered.
Verifies that UNAUTHORIZED_HOST_ATTEMPT alert with severity HIGH is created.

item.name: 06 - Scenario 4: Create Pass for Host 99 (Non-existent -> REJECTED)

request.description: Host 99 does not exist (404 from resident-service), so pass status is REJECTED and UNAUTHORIZED_HOST_ATTEMPT alert generated.
Transitions pass 1 from APPROVED to CHECKED_IN, records checkInTime and CHECK_IN event.

item.name: 08 - Scenario 5 Verification: Check Security Logs for CHECK_IN

request.description: Confirms CHECK_IN log exists in security-alert-service.

item.name: 09 - Scenario 6: Room Security Audit for A-101 (Resident + Active Visitor)

request.description: security-alert-service calls resident-service for A-101 (Aarav, hostId=1) and visitor-pass-service for active passes. Returns resident details and Vikram Malhotra in activeVisitors.
Transitions pass 1 from CHECKED_IN to CHECKED_OUT, records checkOutTime and CHECK_OUT event.

item.name: 11 - Scenario 7 Verification: Check Security Logs for CHECK_OUT

request.description: Confirms CHECK_OUT log exists in security-alert-service.

item.name: 12 - Scenario 8: Room Security Audit for A-101 (Empty Active Visitors)

request.description: Re-checks room A-101 after checkout. activeVisitors array must now be empty.

item.name: 13 - Scenario 9: Check-in on REJECTED Pass 2 (Expect 400 Bad Request)

request.description: Pass 2 is REJECTED. Check-in must be blocked and return HTTP 400 Bad Request.
Lists all visitor passes created in the system.

item.name: 15 - Extra: Get Active Passes for Host 1

request.description: Tests Handoff H3 endpoint directly via gateway.
